title: Penguin Bowling
tagline: Belly-slide a chubby penguin down the ice and knock over snowmen and fish!
howToPlay: Swipe up (or pull back and let go) to slide the penguin down the ice. A curvy swipe makes it curve! On a keyboard, ← → aim and Space slides; ◀ ▶ move the penguin. Bumpers 🛟 keep the penguin out of the gutters. After every roll, count the pins still standing: fallen and standing always make 10. Before a second roll, find where the pins are left, then aim for them. Tap 💭 to guess how many will fall first.
learning: Number bonds to 10, counting, predictions and spatial reasoning
